[Benzinga news, 2026-10-30T13:02:46Z, by staff] Butterfly Network Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Raises Full-Year Guidance
Butterfly Network announced strong third-quarter 2026 financial results, featuring a 52% year-over-year revenue increase and improved profitability metrics, while raising its full-year 2026 outlook.
Butterfly Network reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $32.6 million, representing a 52% increase compared to the same period in 2025. The company significantly narrowed its net loss to $12.8 million from $34.0 million in the prior-year quarter and reported an adjusted EBITDA loss of $1.2 million, an 85% improvement year-over-year. Driven by these results, management raised its full-year 2026 revenue guidance to a range of $123 million to $126 million. Operational highlights included achieving FedRAMP authorization, the commencement of its Home & Community Care program, and the expansion of its Butterfly Embedded™ partnership ecosystem. The company also reported an adjusted EPS of $(0.01), outperforming analyst expectations.
